## The claim

The fused iteration-2 ranking places iteration 1's confirmed pair at rank 1, and no admitted ranking route places that pair below rank 3.

**Prediction if true.** The frozen fused ranking - exported and hashed before any iteration-1 table is read - has the iteration-1 confirmed pair at fused rank 1, and each admitted ranking route (phenotype, likelihood, knowledge) ranks it 3 or better.

**What would refute it.** The fused rank 1 is a different pair, or any admitted ranking route places the pair outside its own top 3.
